description: Website Screenshot. Turn any public URL into a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF asset rendered by BrowserSolver. No local Chromium fleet to operate. Credit cost: 2 credits per call.

block_resources.description: Resource kinds to discard during load, as a comma list (example: image,stylesheet,font). Allowed values: document, eventsource, fetch, font, image, manifest, media, other, script, stylesheet, texttrack, websocket, xhr.

block_urls.description: Substring patterns that should never be fetched (example: analytics,tracking,advertisement). Hosts, paths, or fragments such as .example.com/ work.

cache.description: Serve a stored capture on repeat requests when caching is enabled. Default: false.

cache_ttl.description: Lifetime of cached captures in seconds. Default: 2592000.

delay.description: Additional settle time in seconds after the readiness event. Default: 0.

device.description: Swap the desktop viewport for a preset handset or tablet fingerprint. Allowed values: galaxy_fold4, galaxy_s23, galaxy_s23_ultra, galaxy_s8, huawei_mate_50_pro, huawei_p60_pro, ipad, iphone_12, iphone_13_mini, iphone_13_pro_max, iphone_14_pro, iphone_14_pro_max, iphone_x, pixel_5, pixel_6a, pixel_7_pro, redmi_note_11, redmi_note_12_pro.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: File type returned in the response body. Allowed values: jpeg, jpg, pdf, png, webp. Default: "png".

full_page.description: Extend the capture beyond the viewport so the entire scrollable document is included. Default: false.

full_page_scroll.description: Drive a scroll pass first so deferred content mounts before a tall capture. Default: false.

full_page_scroll_duration.description: Milliseconds spent scrolling prior to a full-height capture. Default: 400.

image_quality.description: Lossy compression level for soft formats. Default: "80".

proxy.description: Route the browser through an intermediate proxy.

remove_ads.description: Best-effort stripping of ad slots before capture. Default: false.

remove_cookie_banners.description: Best-effort removal of cookie consent layers before capture. Default: false.

remove_selectors.description: Hide matching CSS selectors (modals, promo bars, etc.) before shooting.

s3_access_key_id.description: Access key used to authenticate uploads.

s3_bucket.description: Destination bucket for the binary asset.

s3_object_key.description: Key under which the object is stored (generated automatically if blank).

s3_secret_key.description: Secret key used to authenticate uploads.

s3_url.description: Upload the binary and include the public object URL in the API response. Default: false.

scale_factor.description: Pixel density multiplier. Raise it for retina-quality output; files grow accordingly. Default: 1.

selector.description: Limit the shot to one DOM node matched by this CSS selector.

storage_endpoint.description: Override the default AWS endpoint for S3-compatible backends. Leave blank for AWS. R2 example: https://<accountId>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.

url.description: Page address to render into an image or PDF. Must include a protocol.

viewport_height.description: Height of the synthetic desktop window, in pixels. Default: 1024.

viewport_width.description: Width of the synthetic desktop window, in pixels. Default: 1280.

wait_for_selector.description: Hold capture until this CSS node is present.

wait_until.description: Which browser lifecycle event marks the page ready. Allowed values: domcontentloaded, load, networkidle0, networkidle2.

name: website_screenshot
title: Website Screenshot
